# Psalm 147 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Hallelujah! How wonderful it is to sing praises to our God — how delightful and fitting!

**2** The LORD is rebuilding Jerusalem; he is bringing back Israel's scattered exiles.

**3** He heals the brokenhearted and bandages their wounds.

**4** He counts the stars and calls each one by name.

**5** Our Lord is great and incredibly powerful; his wisdom has no limits.

**6** The LORD lifts up the humble and throws the wicked to the ground.

**7** Sing to the LORD with gratitude! Make music to our God on the harp!

**8** He blankets the sky with clouds; he sends rain to the earth; he makes the grass grow on the hillsides.

**9** He feeds the animals and the baby ravens when they cry out.

**10** He doesn't get excited about the strength of a horse or impressed by human muscle.

**11** The LORD's delight is in those who honor him — those who put their hope in his faithful love.

**12** Praise the LORD, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!

**13** He has reinforced the bars of your gates; he has blessed your children within your walls.

**14** He keeps your borders peaceful; he satisfies you with the finest wheat.

**15** He sends his command across the earth — his word moves at incredible speed.

**16** He blankets the ground with snow like wool and sprinkles frost like ashes.

**17** He throws down hailstones like pebbles — who can survive his bitter cold?

**18** Then he sends his word and melts it all; he sends his wind and the waters flow again.

**19** He has revealed his word to Jacob — his laws and regulations to Israel.

**20** He hasn't done this for any other nation — they don't even know his laws. Hallelujah!

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **147:3-4**: Back to back: 'He heals the brokenhearted' and 'He counts the stars.' The God who manages billions of galaxies also knows about your broken heart. That's the God of the Bible — infinitely big and infinitely close.

— PNEUMA
